items.title_orig: Pearl Jam – Daughter (11/06/1993 Mesa Amphitheatre, Arizona) 🚬

items.article_text:
Hello! I was wondering if anyone could help me find out the value of my old Zune collection. Contents include 1 Original Red Zune 8GB (used), 2 Atomic Red Zune HD 16GB (1 opened & used; 1 new factory sealed), a sealed AC adapter, and a car charger (that also has what I believe is a Bluetooth adapter attached?). The batteries seem a little wonky; the original doesn’t power on at all, and the used Zune HD powers on the charger, shows the Zune logo, boots up the Home Screen but blinks off after a bit. I guess after 15 years that makes sense. I remember saving up $ at my first job for these and have fond memories of jamming out to Pearl Jam & watching stoner movies on the Zune HD on the bus to school lol. Thanks for letting me join this community!
    submitted by    /u/joepatre    to    r/Zun
